description: Groundtruth evaluation fixtures for Application status, timeout reconciliation, and crash recovery (IMP-CAR-15, CAR-15, REQ-005, AT-005, AT-006, SRC-C2, SRC-C8)

scenarios.name: External Workday Portal - Timed Out Dispatch
scenarios.description: Candidate dispatched to Workday portal 15 minutes ago (timeout threshold 10 mins). Session must transition to needs_confirmation rather than applied.

confirmation_receipt.notes: Submitted successfully via Workday candidate account.

scenarios.name: Direct ATS - Provider Submission Receipt
scenarios.description: Greenhouse direct ATS board returning explicit candidate submission receipt payload.

scenarios.name: External Employer - Candidate Manual Attestation
scenarios.description: Candidate opened external portal and completed submission, confirming with attestation and confirmation code.

confirmation_receipt.notes: Candidate completed form with confirmed facts. Received confirmation email.

scenarios.name: Worker Crash Recovery - No Duplicate Apply (AT-006)
scenarios.description: Worker crashed after browser dispatch. Session remains in dispatched/needs_confirmation without duplicate re-submission.
